items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I was the first one to give Ray Allen his break.

ctx.x: To learn on. When I went away, my drum. I said, yeah, take them. I had to talk, I was teaching him. I said, now you take them. You get a break, they're yours. So Zooty started playing around here. When I was away, he said, right now, I said, right here. In his big picture, right there now. Old pal Bill, I'll never forget what you did for me. I have never seen Zooty since I left Chicago. But he had a wonderful set of drums at that time. But he think about what I did for him. I said, it seems Zooty. I can leave…
He made a record called Biffley Blues.
